t: Sika 132 Level Rapid is a high-performance, cementitious self-levelling compound designed for smoothing and levelling uneven internal floors. This fast-setting formula is ideal for trade professionals requiring same-day floor covering, making it perfect for busy renovation projects or new builds. It achieves a smooth finish on concrete and wooden subfloors, ready for various flooring types including carpets, vinyl, wood block, ceramic tiles, and laminate. With a coat depth of 2-10mm and a coverage of 3m² per 16kg pack, this rapid compound dries in just 30 minutes, ensuring efficient project completion.
b: Suitable for Interior Concrete & Wooden Floors
Ideal for Same Day Floor Covering
